description: Multiplies a signal by a set amount and adds a fixed voltage to it

params.text: Multiplies the input: silence at the bottom of its travel, the input unchanged at the centre, and twice the input at the top
Adds a fixed voltage to the scaled input, -10V at the bottom of its travel and +10V at the top

inputs.text: The signal to be scaled and offset

outputs.text: The input multiplied by the scale knob, with the offset knob's voltage added
